home.step1Body: Choose a local directory in the terminal. Setup handles sign-in and connects its Git repository or ordinary folder to your Team.
home.step2Body: Review the Instance, Team, Project and conversation sources. Confirm once to install the selected integrations, import history and start ongoing sync.
home.step3Body: The terminal shows sync progress and problems. Closing it leaves background sync running. After a reboot, open ATape and select Start sync.
